description: Fetch the entity card for any tracked type (MCP server, agent, HF model, package) by canonical_key or natural name — all linked facts, categories, HF model license tiers, how to connect, recent events; field captions in fields_note. Name lookup matches exact aliases and canonical keys, not free-form text. Read-only aggregation of daily-collected observatory data; no side effects. Package download days may be missing (npm/PyPI reporting delay); missing days are null with notes, never fake zeros. Use when the user asks about a specific server, agent, model or package.
name: get_entity_profile
title: Get Entity Profile
